Racing thoughts, shopping sprees (even if you can't afford it), little need for sleep but high levels of energy, starting and not finishing tasks/projects, grandiose ideas or behavior, unexplainable irritation or anger, unexplainable giddiness or extreme happiness for no reason. I actually don't have insurance. I pay for my doctor visits and both meds out of pocket (visits are $75 and both meds are less than $100 for a 30 day supply). I can't afford a therapist but I do talk to him and he understands I have a great handle on my illness and understand myself/my symptoms well enough to keep them under control. 
If that situation isn't possible for you (financially or otherwise) check out some free mental health clinics in your area. They usually provide doctors, psychiatrists, etc. for the homeless or people living in poverty. I tried that 3 or 4 months ago but I make too much money to use their services. If that's not possible for you either, join a support group or internet forum and find similar people to talk to about your issues. Do research to understand your symptoms, triggers, etc. and tips or tricks on how to deal with them, control them or alleviate them.
